rounds.prompt: How many coffee beans would it take to brew enough coffee to fill a standard 42 gallon (159 L) oil barrel?
rounds.source: Specialty Coffee Association Golden Cup Standard (55 g of coffee per liter of water) · NIST definition of the petroleum barrel (42 US gallons) · Honest Coffee Guide, average roasted bean weight

rounds.prompt: What is the average depth of the world's oceans?
rounds.source: NOAA National Ocean Service: the average depth of the ocean is about 3,682 meters (12,080 feet), from Charette and Smith (2010), Oceanography 23(2)

rounds.prompt: We all know that 1 lb of feathers weighs more than 1 lb of bricks, but how many chicken feathers does it take to weigh 1 lb (450 g)?
rounds.source: Cobb-Vantress broiler feather data (about 9,000 feathers weighing 74 g) and Feedipedia (FAO/INRAE), feathers as 3 to 7% of a chicken's body weight
